verses.en: And Solomon made affinity with Pharaoh king of Egypt, and took Pharaoh’s daughter, and brought her into the city of David, until he had made an end of building his own house, and the house of the LORD, and the wall of Jerusalem round about.
verses.pt: E Salomão fez parentesco com Faraó, rei do Egito, porque se casou com a filha de Faraó, e a trouxe à cidade de Davi, até que acabasse de edificar a sua própria casa, e a casa do SENHOR, e os muros de Jerusalém em redor.
verses.en_web: Solomon made an alliance with Pharaoh king of Egypt, and took Pharaoh’s daughter, and brought her into David’s city, until he had finished building his own house, Yahweh’s house, and the wall around Jerusalem.
verses.en_bbe: Solomon became the son-in-law of Pharaoh, king of Egypt, and took Pharaoh's daughter as his wife, keeping her in the town of David, till the house he was building for himself, and the house of the Lord and the wall round Jerusalem, were complete.

verses.en: Only the people sacrificed in high places, because there was no house built unto the name of the LORD, until those days.
verses.pt: Todavia o povo sacrificava nos altares dos lugares altos, porque não havia casa edificada ao nome do SENHOR até aqueles tempos.
verses.en_web: However the people sacrificed in the high places, because there was not yet a house built for Yahweh’s name.
verses.en_bbe: But all this time the people were making their offerings in the high places, because no house had been put up to the name of the Lord till those days.

verses.en: And Solomon loved the LORD, walking in the statutes of David his father: only he sacrificed and burnt incense in high places.
verses.pt: Mas Salomão amava ao SENHOR, andando nos estatutos de seu pai Davi, exceto que sacrificava e queimava incenso nos altares dos lugares altos.
verses.en_web: Solomon loved Yahweh, walking in the statutes of David his father; except that he sacrificed and burned incense in the high places.
verses.en_bbe: And Solomon, in his love for the Lord, kept the laws of David his father; but he made offerings and let them go up in smoke on the high places.

verses.en: And the king went to Gibeon to sacrifice there; for that was the great high place: a thousand burnt offerings did Solomon offer upon that altar.
verses.pt: E o rei foi a Gibeão, porque aquele era o principal lugar alto, e Salomão sacrificou ali mil holocaustos sobre aquele altar.
verses.en_web: The king went to Gibeon to sacrifice there; for that was the great high place. Solomon offered a thousand burnt offerings on that altar.
verses.en_bbe: And the king went to Gibeon to make an offering there, because that was the chief high place: it was Solomon's way to make a thousand burned offerings on that altar.

verses.en: In Gibeon the LORD appeared to Solomon in a dream by night: and God said, Ask what I shall give thee.
verses.pt: Em uma noite, o SENHOR apareceu a Salomão em sonhos. E Deus lhe disse: Pede o que queres que eu te dê.
verses.en_web: In Gibeon, Yahweh appeared to Solomon in a dream by night; and God said, “Ask for what I should give you.”
verses.en_bbe: In Gibeon, Solomon had a vision of the Lord in a dream by night; and God said to him, Say what I am to give you.

verses.en: And Solomon said, Thou hast shewed unto thy servant David my father great mercy, according as he walked before thee in truth, and in righteousness, and in uprightness of heart with thee; and thou hast kept for him this great kindness, that thou hast given him a son to sit on his throne, as it is this day.
verses.pt: E Salomão disse: Tu concedeste grande misericórdia a teu servo Davi, meu pai, como também ele andou perante ti em verdade, em justiça, e com um coração correto para contigo; e guardaste-lhe este teu grande benefício, que lhe deste um filho que se assentasse no seu trono, como acontece hoje.
verses.en_web: Solomon said, “You have shown to your servant David my father great loving kindness, because he walked before you in truth, in righteousness, and in uprightness of heart with you. You have kept for him this great loving kindness, that you have given him a son to sit on his throne, as it is today.
verses.en_bbe: And Solomon said, Great was your mercy to David my father, as his life before you was true and upright and his heart was true to you; and you have kept for him this greatest mercy, a son to take his place this day.

verses.en: And now, O LORD my God, thou hast made thy servant king instead of David my father: and I am but a little child: I know not how to go out or come in.
verses.pt: Agora, pois, ó SENHOR meu Deus, constituíste a mim, teu servo, rei em lugar de Davi, meu pai; porém sou um tenro jovem, que não sei como entrar nem sair.
verses.en_web: Now, Yahweh my God, you have made your servant king instead of David my father. I am just a little child. I don’t know how to go out or come in.
verses.en_bbe: And now, O Lord my God, you have made your servant king in the place of David my father; and I am only a young boy, with no knowledge of how to go out or come in.

verses.en: And thy servant is in the midst of thy people which thou hast chosen, a great people, that cannot be numbered nor counted for multitude.
verses.pt: E teu servo está no meio do teu povo que escolheste; um povo grande, que não se pode contar nem numerar por causa de sua multidão.
verses.en_web: Your servant is among your people which you have chosen, a great people, that can’t be numbered or counted for multitude.
verses.en_bbe: And your servant has round him the people of your selection, a people so great that they may not be numbered, and no account of them may be given.

verses.en: Give therefore thy servant an understanding heart to judge thy people, that I may discern between good and bad: for who is able to judge this thy so great a people?
verses.pt: Dá, pois, a teu servo um coração com entendimento para julgar ao teu povo, para discernir entre o bem e o mal; pois quem poderá governar este teu tão grande povo?
verses.en_web: Give your servant therefore an understanding heart to judge your people, that I may discern between good and evil; for who is able to judge this great people of yours?”
verses.en_bbe: Give your servant, then, a wise heart for judging your people, able to see what is good and what evil; for who is able to be the judge of this great people?

verses.en: And the speech pleased the Lord, that Solomon had asked this thing.
verses.pt: E foi do agrado do Senhor que Salomão pedisse isso.
verses.en_web: This request pleased the Lord, that Solomon had asked this thing.
verses.en_bbe: Now these words and Solomon's request were pleasing to the Lord.

verses.en: And God said unto him, Because thou hast asked this thing, and hast not asked for thyself long life; neither hast asked riches for thyself, nor hast asked the life of thine enemies; but hast asked for thyself understanding to discern judgment;
verses.pt: Deus disse-lhe: Porque pediste isto, e não pediste para ti longa vida, nem pediste para ti riquezas, nem pediste a morte de teus inimigos, mas pediste para ti entendimento para compreender a justiça;
verses.en_web: God said to him, “Because you have asked this thing, and have not asked for yourself long life, nor have you asked for riches for yourself, nor have you asked for the life of your enemies, but have asked for yourself understanding to discern justice;
verses.en_bbe: And God said to him, Because your request is for this thing, and not for long life for yourself or for wealth or for the destruction of your haters, but for wisdom to be a judge of causes;

verses.en: Behold, I have done according to thy words: lo, I have given thee a wise and an understanding heart; so that there was none like thee before thee, neither after thee shall any arise like unto thee.
verses.pt: Eis que o fiz conforme as tuas palavras: eis que te dei um coração sábio e com entendimento, tanto que não houve antes de ti outro como tu, nem depois de ti se levantará outro como tu.
verses.en_web: behold, I have done according to your word. Behold, I have given you a wise and understanding heart; so that there has been no one like you before you, and after you none will arise like you.
verses.en_bbe: I have done as you said: I have given you a wise and far-seeing heart, so that there has never been your equal in the past, and never will there be any like you in the future.

verses.en: And I have also given thee that which thou hast not asked, both riches, and honour: so that there shall not be any among the kings like unto thee all thy days.
verses.pt: E também te dei as coisas que não pediste: riquezas e honra; de maneira que, entre os reis, ninguém haverá semelhante a ti em todos os teus dias.
verses.en_web: I have also given you that which you have not asked, both riches and honor, so that there will not be any among the kings like you for all your days.
verses.en_bbe: And with this I have given you what you made no request for: wealth and honour, so that no king was ever your equal.

verses.en: And if thou wilt walk in my ways, to keep my statutes and my commandments, as thy father David did walk, then I will lengthen thy days.
verses.pt: E se andares em meus caminhos, guardando meus estatutos e meus mandamentos, como andou Davi, teu pai, prolongarei teus dias.
verses.en_web: If you will walk in my ways, to keep my statutes and my commandments, as your father David walked, then I will lengthen your days.”
verses.en_bbe: And if you go on in my ways, keeping my laws and my orders as your father David did, I will give you a long life.

verses.en: And Solomon awoke; and, behold, it was a dream. And he came to Jerusalem, and stood before the ark of the covenant of the LORD, and offered up burnt offerings, and offered peace offerings, and made a feast to all his servants.
verses.pt: E quando Salomão despertou, viu que era sonho: e veio a Jerusalém, e apresentou-se diante da arca do pacto do SENHOR, e sacrificou holocaustos, e fez ofertas pacíficas; fez também banquete a todos seus servos.
verses.en_web: Solomon awoke; and behold, it was a dream. Then he came to Jerusalem, and stood before the ark of Yahweh’s covenant, and offered up burnt offerings, offered peace offerings, and made a feast for all his servants.
verses.en_bbe: And Solomon, awakening, saw that it was a dream; then he came to Jerusalem, where he went before the ark of the agreement of the Lord, offering burned offerings and peace-offerings; and he made a feast for all his servants.

verses.en: Then came there two women, that were harlots, unto the king, and stood before him.
verses.pt: Naquela muita vieram duas mulheres prostitutas ao rei, e apresentaram-se diante dele.
verses.en_web: Then two women who were prostitutes came to the king, and stood before him.
verses.en_bbe: Then two loose women of the town came and took their places before the king;

verses.en: And the one woman said, O my lord, I and this woman dwell in one house; and I was delivered of a child with her in the house.
verses.pt: E disse a uma mulher: Ah, senhor meu! Eu e esta mulher morávamos em uma mesma casa, e eu pari estando com ela na casa.
verses.en_web: The one woman said, “Oh, my lord, I and this woman dwell in one house. I delivered a child with her in the house.
verses.en_bbe: And one of them said, O my lord, I and this woman are living in the same house; and I gave birth to a child by her side in the house.

verses.en: And it came to pass the third day after that I was delivered, that this woman was delivered also: and we were together; there was no stranger with us in the house, save we two in the house.
verses.pt: E aconteceu ao terceiro dia depois que eu dei à luz, que esta deu à luz também, e morávamos nós juntas; ninguém de fora estava em casa, a não ser nós duas na casa.
verses.en_web: The third day after I delivered, this woman delivered also. We were together. There was no stranger with us in the house, just us two in the house.
verses.en_bbe: And three days after the birth of my child, this woman had a child: we were together, no other-person was with us in the house but we two only.

verses.en: And this woman’s child died in the night; because she overlaid it.
verses.pt: E uma noite o filho desta mulher morreu, porque ela se deitou sobre ele.
verses.en_web: This woman’s child died in the night, because she lay on it.
verses.en_bbe: In the night, this woman, sleeping on her child, was the cause of its death.

verses.en: And she arose at midnight, and took my son from beside me, while thine handmaid slept, and laid it in her bosom, and laid her dead child in my bosom.
verses.pt: E levantou-se à meia noite, e tomou a meu filho de junto a mim, estando eu tua serva dormindo, e o pôs a seu lado, e pôs a meu lado seu filho morto.
verses.en_web: She arose at midnight, and took my son from beside me, while your servant slept, and laid it in her bosom, and laid her dead child in my bosom.
verses.en_bbe: And she got up in the middle of the night and took my son from my side while your servant was sleeping; and she took it in her arms and put her dead child in my arms.

verses.en: And when I rose in the morning to give my child suck, behold, it was dead: but when I had considered it in the morning, behold, it was not my son, which I did bear.
verses.pt: E quando eu me levantei pela manhã para dar o peito a meu filho, eis que que estava morto: mas observei-lhe pela manhã, e vi que não era meu filho, que eu havia dado à luz.
verses.en_web: When I rose in the morning to nurse my child, behold, it was dead; but when I had looked at it in the morning, behold, it was not my son, whom I bore.”
verses.en_bbe: And when I got up to give my child the breast, I saw that it was dead; but in the morning, looking at it with care, I saw that it was not my son.

verses.en: And the other woman said, Nay; but the living is my son, and the dead is thy son. And this said, No; but the dead is thy son, and the living is my son. Thus they spake before the king.
verses.pt: Então a outra mulher disse: Não; meu filho é o que vive, e teu filho é o morto. E a outra voltou a dizer: Não; teu filho é o morto, e meu filho é o que vive. Assim falavam diante do rei.
verses.en_web: The other woman said, “No; but the living one is my son, and the dead one is your son.” The first one said, “No; but the dead one is your son, and the living one is my son.” Thus they spoke before the king.
verses.en_bbe: And the other woman said, No; but the living child is my son and the dead one yours. But the first said, No; the dead child is your son and the living one mine. So they kept on talking before the king.

verses.en: Then said the king, The one saith, This is my son that liveth, and thy son is the dead: and the other saith, Nay; but thy son is the dead, and my son is the living.
verses.pt: O rei então disse: Esta disse: Meu filho é o que vive, e teu filho é o morto: e a outra disse: Não, mas o teu é o morto, e meu filho é o que vive.
verses.en_web: Then the king said, “One says, ‘This is my son who lives, and your son is the dead;’ and the other says, ‘No; but your son is the dead one, and my son is the living one.’”
verses.en_bbe: Then the king said, One says, The living child is my son, and yours is the dead: and the other says, Not so; but your son is the dead one and mine is the living.

verses.en: And the king said, Bring me a sword. And they brought a sword before the king.
verses.pt: E disse o rei: Trazei-me uma espada. E trouxeram ao rei uma espada.
verses.en_web: The king said, “Get me a sword.” So they brought a sword before the king.
verses.en_bbe: Then he said, Get me a sword. So they went and put a sword before the king.

verses.en: And the king said, Divide the living child in two, and give half to the one, and half to the other.
verses.pt: Em seguida o rei disse: Parti por meio o menino vivo, e dai a metade à uma, e a outra metade à outra.
verses.en_web: The king said, “Divide the living child in two, and give half to the one, and half to the other.”
verses.en_bbe: And the king said, Let the living child be cut in two and one half given to one woman and one to the other.

verses.en: Then spake the woman whose the living child was unto the king, for her bowels yearned upon her son, and she said, O my lord, give her the living child, and in no wise slay it. But the other said, Let it be neither mine nor thine, but divide it.
verses.pt: Então a mulher cujo era o filho vivo, falou ao rei (porque suas entranhas se lhe comoveram por seu filho), e disse: Ah, senhor meu! Dai a esta o menino vivo, e não o mateis. Mas a outra disse: nem a mim nem a ti; parti-o.
verses.en_web: Then the woman whose the living child was spoke to the king, for her heart yearned over her son, and she said, “Oh, my lord, give her the living child, and in no way kill him!” But the other said, “He shall be neither mine nor yours. Divide him.”
verses.en_bbe: Then the mother of the living child came forward, for her heart went out to her son, and she said, O my lord, give her the child; do not on any account put it to death. But the other woman said, It will not be mine or yours; let it be cut in two.

verses.en: Then the king answered and said, Give her the living child, and in no wise slay it: she is the mother thereof.
verses.pt: Então o rei respondeu, e disse: Dai a aquela o filho vivo, e não o mateis: ela é sua mãe.
verses.en_web: Then the king answered, “Give her the living child, and definitely do not kill him. She is his mother.”
verses.en_bbe: Then the king made answer and said, Give her the child, and do not put it to death; she is the mother of it.

verses.en: And all Israel heard of the judgment which the king had judged; and they feared the king: for they saw that the wisdom of God was in him, to do judgment.
verses.pt: E todo Israel ouviu aquele juízo que havia dado o rei: e temeram ao rei, porque viram que havia nele sabedoria de Deus para julgar.
verses.en_web: All Israel heard of the judgment which the king had judged; and they feared the king; for they saw that the wisdom of God was in him, to do justice.
verses.en_bbe: And news of this decision which the king had made went through all Israel; and they had fear of the king, for they saw that the wisdom of God was in him to give decisions.
